test_td_learning: test the value_ops.td_learning function computes target, td_error, loss, and gradients correctly
test_td_lambda: test the value_ops.td_lambda function computes loss, temporal differences, and discounted returns with configurable lambda
test_generalized_lambda_returns: test the value_ops.generalized_lambda_returns function computes generalized lambda returns from rewards, pcontinues, and state values
test_qv_max: test the value_ops.qv_max function computes QVMAX loss using q-values, target values, and gradients
test_rank_compatibility_checks: test that td_learning, td_lambda, and qv_max raise ValueError on rank or shape mismatch inputs
